title: C22 — MEXC Out-of-Sample Cross-Venue Replication (SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN)
why_c22: C1-C20 closed NO_GO on OKX + Binance UM perps; C21-T1 confirmed temporal/regime stability of that NO_GO. Before abandoning the edge, C22 asks a NEW-DATA question: does the unchanged spec-literal edge replicate on an independent venue (MEXC) never used before? This is new data + a frozen spec, not a same-data rerun and not a parameter search.

strata.definition: venue funding rate sign at crash day; neutral when venue has no funding history

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over fold totals + cross-venue sign concordance vs recorded OKX/Binance

decision_rules.STABLE_POSITIVE_SUBSET: >=1 pre-specified venue-fold or pooled stratum survives BH correction with bootstrap CI excluding 0 & positive spot leg, permutation p<0.05, placebo p_ge_canonical<0.05, effective N>= floor, AND same-direction effect in the other venue(s) or flagged single-venue exploratory (MEXC is the new venue; OKX/Binance are the recorded priors).
decision_rules.NO_GO: no stratum survives BH correction; pooled CI spans 0; spot non-positive across most folds (corroborates the C1-C21 NO_GO).
decision_rules.UNDERPOWERED: per-fold N below floor, or missing seed/SHA binding / compute predating this prereg.
decision_rules.rule: Always report per-fold, per-venue, and pooled numbers plus the power curve — never a bare token.

provenance.provenance_caveat: Real MEXC USDT-perp exchange data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NOT Hyperliquid performance evidence and must never be relabelled as such. Multi-year window 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z..2026-09-28T23:00:00Z (32808 hourly bars/symbol).

guardrails: Cross-venue real MEXC data only; never relabel as Hyperliquid (is_hyperliquid_venue_data=false).
Config is FROZEN to the spec-literal values above; no parameter tuning after results.
Folds and strata are fixed here, before compute; no post-hoc bin/fold invention.
Do NOT reduce draw counts: 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo / 2k strata floors preserved.
No synthetic gap-fill; symbols not listed for the full window are excluded (coverage=false), never fabricated.
The C1-C21 NO_GO stands unless C22 produces a pre-registered contradiction with full evidence.
MEXC is the NEW venue; a same-data C22+ rerun on OKX/Binance is forbidden. New direction beyond C22 needs new prereg + new data + explicit authorization.
Report per-fold, per-venue, and pooled numbers plus the power curve — never a bare token.
